t: Bosch multi-tool blade with Starlock mount for maximum power transfer and fast blade changes. Designed for plunge cutting in hardwood or wooden boards and sawing in wooden panels. Features Japanese tooth configuration consisting of sharp ground teeth for cutting hardwood, minimising heat development for tear-free cuts. Flat design blade reduces wobbling to ensure a controlled cut. Curved-Tec rounded edges offers precise, smooth cuts, with laser-etched depth gauge. Colour-coded for easy blade identification. Fits all common multi-tools.
b: Cuts Hardwood, Softwood, Wood Composites & Plastics
